subject: Dedicated pool sizing & committed pricing — Clearwave proposal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jordan <emily.jordan@clearwave.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial sizing + committed pool proposal for Clearwave

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is an initial recommended configuration for a Dedicated GPU pool based on the workload summary you shared (attached CSV). Key assumptions are listed inline so we can align before I convert to a formal quote: 

• Workload basis: 20k API calls/day average, 1,200 tokens/request (median 480, 95th 1,600) — see CSV.
• Peak concurrency observed: 42 concurrent inference requests during morning batch windows.
• Model: open-llm-family LlamaX-13B quantized to int8 (latency profiles included).

Recommendation (proposed):
• Pool: 4 × NVIDIA A100 80GB (shared across Clearwave tenant)
• Provisioning target: sustain 35 rps aggregate, p95 end-to-end request latency < 850ms (for 1,200 token responses)
• Reserved commit: 4-GPU equivalent dedicated pool, monthly commit term (1-month trial then 12-month optional)
• Suggested price (list): $58,000/month — includes 24/7 runbook, 99.9% uptime SLA, and standard telemetry retention.
• Burst policy: +50% burst available for short windows at on-demand rate; included warm cache on failover.

If you can confirm average tokens per request and whether any requests will exceed 4k context, I can tighten the sizing. I've attached the workload CSV and a readable PDF of the proposal.

Next steps: confirm two things (1) target commit length (6 vs 12 months), (2) peak concurrency headroom needed for holiday/clinical spikes. Happy to hop on a 30-min call.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Emily Jordan <emily.jordan@clearwave.health>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial sizing + committed pool proposal for Clearwave

Thanks Connor — very helpful breakdown. A few clarifications from our side: 

• Confirmed: 20k/day average, but we have weekly peaks up to ~38k/day (billing ingestion windows).
• Typical median tokens ~400; user-initiated report generation can run 3–5k tokens but those are <1% of requests (we can route those to a different queue if needed).
• Peak concurrency: 60 concurrent inference jobs for a sustained 20–30 minute window on Tuesdays (ET).

Pricing feedback: the $58k/month sticker is a bit above our procurement target. We are looking at a committed vendor with predictable unit economics and hope to keep committed pool spend < $45k/month. We are open to a 12-month commitment for a deeper discount if you can preserve the throughput SLOs.

Also: procurement wants the ability to add an on-prem node for worst-case offline operations (air-gapped fallback) — can you confirm if Redwood supports an optional private on-prem stub with the same model versions?

cc: procurement@clearwave.health (Alex Park)

—Emily
Emily Jordan
Head of ML Ops, Clearwave Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-30T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Initial sizing + committed pool proposal for Clearwave — they asked for price & on-prem fallback

Marissa / Vanessa — FYI. Clearwave pushed back on $58k -> target < $45k/month with willingness to do 12-month commit. Requirements: handle occasional large requests (3–5k tokens <1%), sustained peak concurrency ~60 for 20–30 minutes, weekly peaks to 38k/day. They also want an on-prem fallback option.

Attached is their CSV and our draft proposal. Any room on pricing if we structure it as a multi-tier commit w/ burst credits + optional short-term on-prem appliance?

Thanks — Connor

[Attachment: clearwave_workload_summary.csv]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-30T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Initial sizing + committed pool proposal for Clearwave — pricing playbook

Connor — good thread. Pricing playbook proposal: 

Option A (12-month commit, performance SLOs):
• 4 × A100 pool (same config)
• Monthly commit: $49,500/month (15% discount off list)
• Included: 40 TB telemetry retention, 99.9% uptime, 24/7 on-call, two scheduled capacity bumps per year
• Burst: +50% at a reduced on-demand uplift (we absorb warm cache time)
• SLA credits: 5% credit per SLO miss up to 20%

Option B (6-month commit):
• $53,000/month (8.5% discount)
• Same SLAs but limited to 2 scheduled capacity bumps

Add-on: Private on-prem fallback appliance — one-time setup $40k + monthly 4-GPU support fee $4,500 (replicated model artifacts + sync tooling).

Why this structure: gets them under $45k net if they prepay 3 months of the 12-month option or we offer an upfront commit credit. If they need tighter economics we can add a usage rebate for token overage under 12-months.

If Vanessa agrees, I can convert Option A into a formal amended proposal and push to DocuSign. Thoughts?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Initial sizing + committed pool proposal for Clearwave — pricing playbook

Agree with Marissa. Two small edits before sending:
1) Add a clear overage tier for large-report traffic (route to a different queue at lower priority) — $0.0035 per token above committed baseline.
2) Offer a 30-day trial window on the pool (partial credit applied to first invoice) so they can validate concurrency behavior during their Tuesday spike.

I'll draft the DocuSign wrapper (standard T&Cs + SLA term-sheet) once you confirm the final monthly figure. Recommend we start with Option A at $49,500/mo and include a 10% prepay credit if they prepay 3 months. That lands them under $45k effective for Q1 of the term.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Jordan <emily.jordan@clearwave.health>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwave.health>
Date: 2026-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing & committed pricing — Clearwave proposal

Appreciate the quick work here. Option A looks workable with the prepay credit and the 30-day trial — two final asks before we sign: 

1) Can you explicitly call out the emergency on-prem standby option in the DocuSign (we will need the one-time setup + monthly fee as a separate line item).
2) Add a sentence guaranteeing model artifact parity between hosted Dedicated and on-prem fallback (same quantized artifacts + model version pinning).

If you can add those items and send the DocuSign, procurement will review and aim to return signed within 5 business days.

—Emily
Emily Jordan
Head of ML Ops, Clearwave Health
[Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf]
